sentences: GFX10 VOP1 opcode 104: swap `VGPR[D + M0[25:16]]` and `VGPR[S0 + M0[9:0]]`, the two M0 fields `v_movrelsd_2_b32` uses; the other M0 bits are ignored (RDNA2 ISA opcode description).
Both registers are read before either is written.
When both name one register it keeps its value.
Inactive lanes keep both registers (`OpSelect` on `active`).
As for `v_movrel*`, the hardware's range check against the VGPR allocation is not modelled.
CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_alu_swaprel.py` (both fields, ignored M0 bits, a self-swap, a register-file model).

**Hardware-verified on RDNA2** (`gfx1035`, Windows 11, driver `26.5.1`, wave32 & wave64 via `tools/int_hw_probe.py --oracle both --group valu_swaprel`): M0[25:16] & M0[9:0] offsets, ignored upper M0 bits (`0xfc01fc02`), self-swap, and inactive EXEC lanes all match bit-for-bit.
